existing.description: The SAF Merit Scholarship is a top-tier military scholarship offered by MINDEF/SAF to Singapore citizens and permanent residents intending to take up citizenship. It pays full tuition fees and other approved academic charges, a monthly salary for the duration of studies, maintenance and other allowances, return airfare and a one-time sponsorship for summer exchange programmes, and can sponsor up to six years of studies inclusive of a Master's degree. Recipients must qualify for and excel in Officer Cadet School and serve a six-year bond in MINDEF/SAF after graduation.
eligibility: Singapore citizen or permanent resident intending to take up Singapore citizenship
Good GCE 'A' Level or International Baccalaureate results, Polytechnic Diploma (with Merit) or equivalent
Qualify for and excel in Officer Cadet School
Possess a strong interest in a military career
All MINDEF/SAF scholarships are open for application to both genders
existing.eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens or permanent residents intending to take up Singapore citizenship, with good GCE 'A' Level, International Baccalaureate or Polytechnic Diploma (with Merit) results or equivalent, good co-curricular activities records and strong leadership qualities, who qualify for and excel in Officer Cadet School and have a strong interest in a military career. Open to both genders.
benefits: Monthly salary for the duration of studies
Full tuition fees and other approved academic charges
Maintenance and other allowances, e.g. books, clothing, computer

requirements: Applicants are expected to apply to universities themselves, as admission is dependent on individual merit
Arrange to sit necessary pre-admission tests such as SAT where required

Law graduates will not be called to the Bar while serving in MINDEF/SAF
application_method: Submit the scholarship application online through the MINDEF scholarship portal at https://go.gov.sg/mindef-saf-scholarship
The MINDEF page states the same URL is the fallback if the online portal cannot be accessed
existing.selection_notes: The selection board looks for leadership potential, sound character, commitment to serve Singapore and Singaporeans, and a keen interest in a challenging and fulfilling profession with MINDEF/SAF. For females there are up to three rounds of interviews, with the final round assessing military performance in Officer Cadet School before the scholarship is confirmed.
existing.best_fit: Singapore citizen or permanent resident school leavers with strong academic and co-curricular records who intend to serve as an SAF officer and can meet the physical and Officer Cadet School entry requirements.
existing.duration: Sponsorship for up to 6 years of studies, inclusive of a Master's if applicable; FAQ states a stipulated study period of four years
existing.application_period: Male applicants: 1 September to 30 April of the following year. Female applicants: 1 April to 31 August.
